messages:
harper_sales: Customer (MedSys) asked whether our on-prem air-gapped POC can do node-by-node rolling upgrades without manual node restarts and what the billing looks like for emergency patching during a 3-month POC. They also need explicit wording for the security questionnaire about artifact signing and a short rollback playbook.

diego_se: TL;DR: operator supports orchestrated rolling updates in air-gapped clusters if images are available in a local registry or preloaded on nodes. For minimal user-visible impact, stateful components must be replicated (>=2). We can automate cordon/drain/update/uncordon.

mira_eng: technical note: we ship "minibundles" (full) and "delta bundles" (patch layers + manifest mapping). Delta bundles reduce transfer but depend on stable layer digests. If the customer's registry mirrors or mutates digests (some proxies re-chunk layers) we detect that in preflight and either produce a manifest-mapping or fall back to a full minibundle. Recommend a staging preflight run.

ops_jun: Patching SLA: for the POC we can offer an optional "POC emergency patch" add-on: 48h response and signed delta/minibundle delivery (includes remote assist for import). Pricing will be a flat monthly surcharge for the POC term. If preflight indicates registry id-mutation, we may need an additional one-time import verification fee.

harper_sales: can you give a 2-line SOW blurb and a 3-step rollback playbook I can paste into the SOW?

diego_se: SOW blurb: "Redwood will provide signed offline artifacts and an operator to coordinate node-by-node rolling updates in air-gapped environments. High availability requires replicated services; database schema changes should be scheduled and tested in staging. Monthly security drops plus an optional 48-hour emergency patch add-on are available for the POC term."

mira_eng: Rollback playbook (short):
```
1) On jumpbox, import previous minibundle: ctr images import previous-bundle.tar.gz
2) On cluster, annotate workloads to pin previous image digests and restart pods: kubectl rollout restart statefulset/<svc>
3) Monitor: kubectl get pods -n redwood --watch; if progress stalls, uncordon nodes and open support ticket with Redwood SRE
```

ops_jun: Verification snippet for questionnaire (add to their security doc):
```
# on jumpbox after transfer
sha256sum bundle-2026-06-01.tar.gz
cosign verify-blob --key redwood_pub.pem --signature bundle-2026-06-01.tar.gz.sig bundle-2026-06-01.tar.gz
ctr images import bundle-2026-06-01.tar.gz
# run preflight to detect registry digest rewriting
redwood-preflight --registry registry.local:5000 --check-digests
```

mira_eng: operational caveat to call out: delta bundles speed transfers but require a consistent content-addressable graph. If customer's mirror rewrites digests we either ship a manifest-mapping file (adds ~10-30min to import process) or deliver a full minibundle. Mention this in the SOW appendix.

harper_sales: I'll email the customer with SOW blurb, rollback playbook, pricing note for emergency patch add-on, verification snippet, and request that they provision a jumpbox with scp access and a mirror registry endpoint for the preflight. Anyone object?

diego_se: No objections. Also recommend they enable a mirrored staging cluster with identical registry behavior for validating delta bundles before POC run.

signing-bot: bundle 2026-06-01 created by @mira_eng (sha256:0a1b2c3d...); detached signature uploaded to secure-store.
